title: Father & Daughter on Porch Steps, 1953 Baton Rouge B&W Snapshot Photo

Hilary & Bob in

description: A heartwarming 1950s black-and-white snapshot capturing a father and his young toddler daughter sitting together on the concrete front porch steps of a suburban home in Baton Rouge, Louisiana. The father, identified on the reverse as Bob, is smartly dressed in a sport coat, collared shirt, and slacks, smiling lovingly at the little girl, Hilary, who wears a light dress and white socks. In the background, a neat suburban neighborhood with manicured lawns, a neighboring home, and a classic 1950s sedan parked across the street highlights post-WWII American suburban life.
